name: Abortion
overview: Scripture affirms the sanctity of human life, declaring that God will require accountability for the shedding of blood, whether by man or beast (Genesis 9:5). The commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) underscores the divine prohibition against taking innocent life. Specifically, if a pregnant woman is harmed and her child is lost, the offender must face punishment, reflecting the value placed on the unborn (Exodus 21:22-23). Furthermore, the law condemns those who accept bribes to kill the innocent, emphasizing that all human life is precious and protected under God's justice (Leviticus 24:17; Deuteronomy 27:25).
